Term 1 Week 1.label: Term 1 — Week 1
Term 1 Week 1.competency: Measurement and Geometry Describe a 12- and 24-hour clock system. Convert 12-hour time to 24-hour time, and vice-versa. Solve problems involving 12- and 24-hour time.
